about: What tools/bundle/build.mjs builds for the redesign's pages, from the files in widget/ (the live pages keep loading those files themselves). scripts: 'hold' files are held until the page asks for one (window.SH_BUNDLE.run), the way it would have added that file's own <script>; 'run' files run as the bundle loads, in this order, after the held ones are in place. A bundle's 'css' is a stylesheet only its files need (widget/v3.css styles what widget/v3.js draws, and would restyle the dashboard's widgets if it were in the shared sheet): it goes in as a <style> ahead of the page's stylesheet, where a hub has always had it. styles: the parts of the one stylesheet every redesigned page links, in cascade order. A file under vendor/ goes in as it is. The smoke test and the preview read this file too.

hub.bundle.js.what: a hub's engine: with the page

dash.bundle.js.what: the dashboard's engine: with the page

rest.bundle.js.what: the widgets a hub and the dashboard share, and the database client: once the page is drawn

hub-rest.bundle.js.what: a hub's own widget layer (widget/v3.js and what it loads): after rest.bundle.js
